title: AgentHarm: A Benchmark for Measuring Harmfulness of LLM Agents

layout.note: Two mirrored horizontal lanes, harmful request on top and benign request below, each running left to right: user pictogram, grey arrow, robot agent with reply bubble, tool-calling loop. A single tall yellow rounded panel of tool icons closes both lanes at the right. No frames or lane dividers; whitespace separates the lanes.

lesson: Tell a safety benchmark's setting with two mirrored lanes that use the same agent icon, so only the request pictogram and the green or pink reply bubble change, and close both lanes with one shared tinted panel of tool icons.
